integrity: Proof gives an exact all-parameter kernel, rank, sign classification, disjointness count, endpoint norms, and balanced-rank limit; finite rational checks are corroborative and not an infinite proof. No independent audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Exact only for the first nonconstant finite Grassmann harmonic projector on k-subspaces with k at most n/2; the asymptotic fixes a prime power q and codimension excess s. No result for higher harmonics or intermediate Lp norms.
title: Exact endpoint norms and Euler-product scaling for the first Grassmann Fourier projection
